mentions.name: subedit
mentions.description: An AI-native linter and formatter for AI-generated code comments and Markdown. It automatically fixes style misalignments deterministically, and when a problem cannot be fixed by reformatting, it invokes AI via a hook to regenerate the content.
mentions.problem: AI-generated code comments or Markdown usually doesn't match the author's preferred style.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built an AI-native linter and formatter, which automatically fixes the style or asks AI via a hook to regenerate if something is misaligned but cannot be reformatted deterministically.
mentions.author: mroops0111
